entities.summary: The Presbyterian Church of Korea, also known as Yejang Tonghap (Korean: 예장통합) or just Tonghap, is a mainline Protestant denomination based in South Korea; it currently has the second largest membership of any Presbyterian denomination in the world. Presbyterian Church in Korea (TongHap) is a Christian denomination in Asia, established in 1884. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
